# Check declared vendor modules against the actual imported file set

At 1245, third_party/rust/ews/src/types.rs declared pub mod update_item, but types/update_item.rs was absent. The next landing adds that imported file. The Git presence check proves this exact declaration/file gap without inventing a compiler diagnostic. When importing this dependency, check that declared modules and tracked files agree as well as the manifest and lock metadata. Current ews_xpcom uses a registry dependency and a newer lock version, so the old Git pin is historical. Imported module bodies remain excluded from our manual coding-style rules. These conclusions come from static source inspection. No runtime test or accessibility session was run. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion remains pending.

Scope: EWS vendor module completeness.
